sloka: ततो जित्वा दशग्रीवो यमं त्रिदशपुङ्गवम् ।रावणस्तु रणश्लाघी स्वसहायान्ददर्श ह ।। ७.२३.१ ॥
transliteration: tato jitvā daśagrīvo yamaṁ tridaśapuṅgavam ।rāvaṇastu raṇaślāghī svasahāyāndadarśa ha ।। 7.23.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, having conquered Yama, the chief among the gods, Ravana, who boasted of his prowess in battle, indeed saw his own companions.
